hooks.name: Remind to reinstall on requirements.txt change
hooks.description: When requirements.txt is saved, remind the user to reinstall packages into the venv.

action.prompt:
The file `requirements.txt` was just saved. Remind the user to reinstall dependencies by running the following command in their terminal:

```
.venv\Scripts\pip.exe install -r requirements.txt
```

Also mention: if they added a new package, they should pin the version and run `pip freeze > requirements.txt` after installing to keep the file in sync. Keep the message brief and actionable.
